videoDescription.headline: HydraLUME V10 – deep cleansing, rejuvenation and firming in one machine
paragraphs: The HydraLUME V10 works with vortex hydrodermabrasion: its rotating, swirling suction removes blackheads and impurities from enlarged pores. This cleansing is the foundation of every further treatment.

Alongside it there is an arm-mounted, five-wing LED panel for light therapy, and 12 separate handpieces for face lifting, wrinkle reduction, acne treatment, hydration and scalp care. This lets you build a complete facial treatment protocol from one machine, from cleansing to the finishing step.

featureRows.headline: Why choose the HydraLUME V10?
featureRows.subtitle: Vortex hydrodermabrasion, LED light therapy and 12 handpieces in one plug-in facial care center on wheels.

features.title: Vortex hydrodermabrasion system
features.description: The vortex technique uses rotating suction: thanks to the swirling motion, cleansing is more precise and removes blackheads and pore impurities more thoroughly. It improves skin texture and is a stable foundation for every further treatment.
features.highlight: Cleansing is the foundation that every further step builds on.

features.title: LED light therapy with an adjustable panel
features.description: A five-wing, arm-mounted LED panel that covers the whole face. Use it for skin rejuvenation, evening out skin tone and finishing the treatment; the wings can be adjusted to the client's face.

features.title: Firming, face lifting, wrinkle reduction
features.description: Separate handpieces for skin-firming and anti-aging treatments, so you can build a complete rejuvenation protocol from one machine. All 12 handpieces sit in the machine's holder, within reach during the treatment.

features.title: Acne treatment and hydration
features.description: There is a solution for blemish-prone, oily and dehydrated skin too. After cleansing, you hydrate and soothe the skin on the same machine – the client does not have to move to another device.

features.title: Scalp and hair care, easy operation
features.description: With the comb handpiece, scalp care joins your list of services. Plug-in design: plug it in and you are ready to go, no complicated installation. The large display brings every function together in one place.
features.highlight: A new service for your existing clients.

faq.question: How is vortex hydrodermabrasion different from conventional vacuum cleansing?
faq.answer: The vortex technique does not suck in a straight line but with rotation: thanks to the swirling motion, cleansing is more precise and removes blackheads and pore impurities more thoroughly. Skin texture looks smoother after the very first treatment.

faq.question: Which handpieces come with the machine?
faq.answer: 12 separate handpieces and a five-wing LED panel. With the handpieces you can perform deep cleansing, firming and face lifting, wrinkle reduction, acne treatment, hydration and, with the comb handpiece, scalp care.

faq.question: What can the LED panel be used for?
faq.answer: For skin rejuvenation, evening out skin tone and finishing the treatment. The five-wing, arm-mounted panel covers the whole face and can be adjusted to the client's face.

faq.question: Does it need any installation or special wiring?
faq.answer: No. The HydraLUME V10 has a plug-in design and runs on 110–220 V mains power: plug it in and you are ready to go. The machine stands on a wheeled base, so it is easy to move around the treatment room.

faq.question: How much space and weight should I plan for?
faq.answer: The machine is a free-standing model on wheels with a stainless steel frame, weighing 47 kg. The LED panel's support arm is foldable, so it takes up less space when not in use.

faq.question: Does the machine come with training?
faq.answer: Yes. The price includes individual, personalized training, along with course material and ongoing support. We schedule the training date with you.

faq.question: Can I see the machine before buying?
faq.answer: Yes. You can see and try the HydraLUME V10 in person at our showroom in Érd (2030 Érd, Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út 156.) by prior appointment.
